Why these are unassigned. Action Network stores no team id on a hand-typed free-form pick, and the description names a player rather than a club. Matching those nicknames against the roster in data/fp.json was tried and rejected: it resolves "Kyler" to a Kyler on Minnesota rather than Kyler Murray, and misplaces "Monty" and "Willis" the same way. Filing them here is the honest answer.
  • Tickets naming two clubs in one division are shown as division-order tickets, not filed under whichever club was typed first.
